fourQuestionValueTest: Does this materially improve championship probability now or create a clearly superior five-year path?
Are we acquiring the asset below intrinsic/market value or selling above it?
What is the full opportunity cost across five years including cap, contract, roster spot, replacement value, draft capital and flexibility?
Is there a materially better alternative available now or likely to become available within the decision window?

principles: Private league context is sent only to a provider whose published data-use policy excludes training and service improvement.
Gemini receives only explicit-consent user text and public NFL context.
Statistics and cap math come from shared deterministic calculation tools where possible.
Verified facts, current external information, user thesis and model inference remain separately labeled.
